---
title: "Pookalam Registration"  
toc: false
---  
```{=html}
<style>
  :root{
    --brand:#e68a00; --brand-2:#b36b00; --bg:#fffaf3; --ink:#222;
  }

  /* ---------- REGISTRATION FORM SECTION ---------- */
  .reg-wrap{
    max-width:720px;
    margin:32px auto;
    padding:0 14px;
    font-family:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .reg-card{
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:16px;
    padding:18px 16px 22px;
    box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
    border:1px solid #f1e3d2;
  }
  .reg-card h3{
    margin:2px 0 4px;
    color:var(--brand-2);
    font-size:1.2rem;
    line-height:1.35;
  }
  .reg-card p{
    margin:6px 0 14px;
    line-height:1.55;
    font-size:.98rem;
    color:#444;
  }
  .form-embed{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    border-radius:12px;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid #f1e3d2;
  }
  /* Tall on mobile so the whole form scrolls inside naturally */
  .form-embed iframe{
    display:block;
    width:100%;
    height:1400px;      /* generous height => less nested scrolling on phones */
    border:0;
  }

  /* Sticky "Open in new tab" fallback for phones that render the embed poorly */
  .open-fallback{
    text-align:center;
    margin:14px 0 2px;
  }
  .open-fallback a{
    display:inline-block;
    padding:.8rem 1.5rem;
    font-size:1rem;
    font-weight:600;
    color:#fff;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand),var(--brand-2));
    border-radius:999px;
    text-decoration:none;
    box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(230,138,0,.3);
  }
  .open-fallback small{
    display:block;
    margin-top:8px;
    color:#8a5200;
    font-size:.85rem;
  }

  @media (max-width:600px){
    .reg-card{ padding:14px 12px 18px; }
    .reg-card h3{ font-size:1.08rem; }
    .form-embed iframe{ height:1550px; }
  }
</style>

<div class="reg-wrap">
  <div class="reg-card">
    <h3>🌸 Pookalam registration | പൂക്കളം രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ</h3>
    <p>
      Fill the form below to register your team. On mobile, scroll down inside
      the form to reach every question, then tap <strong>Submit</strong>.<br>
      നിങ്ങളുടെ ടീമിനെ രജിസ്റ്റർ ചെയ്യാൻ താഴെയുള്ള ഫോം പൂരിപ്പിക്കുക.
    </p>

    <div class="form-embed">
      <iframe
        src="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfZqbYtKhEx2-HCGARtQyB6uvdFpeVpukSQ1jz2gL7WUfvBHA/viewform?embedded=true"
        loading="lazy" allowfullscreen>
        Loading…
      </iframe>
    </div>

    <div class="open-fallback">
      <a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfZqbYtKhEx2-HCGARtQyB6uvdFpeVpukSQ1jz2gL7WUfvBHA/viewform"
         target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        ഫോം പുതിയ ടാബിൽ തുറക്കുക / Open form in full screen
      </a>
      <small>Trouble filling here? Open the form in a new tab.</small>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<!-- Register Button -->
<div class="register-btn-wrap">
  <a href="pookalamrules.html" class="register-btn">നിയമങ്ങൾ കാണാൻ ക്ലിക്ക് ചെയ്യുക/Rules</a>
</div>

<style>
  .register-btn-wrap{
    text-align:center;
    margin:2rem 0;
  }
  .register-btn{
    display:inline-block;
    padding:.9rem 1.6rem;
    font-size:1.05rem;
    font-weight:600;
    color:#fff;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6b46c1,#9f7aea);
    border-radius:999px;
    text-decoration:none;
    box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(111,61,204,.3);
    transition:all .25s ease;
  }
  .register-btn:hover,
  .register-btn:focus{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5a38a8,#7d5ac9);
    box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(111,61,204,.45);
    transform:translateY(-2px);
  }
</style>
```
